name: MALIK-MD WhatsApp Bot
description: A powerful, multi-device WhatsApp bot built with Node.js and @whiskeysockets/baileys. Deployable on Heroku.

SESSION_ID.description: Your Base64 encoded SESSION_ID. Generate this from a session generator app.

MODE.description: Set bot's working mode. Use 'public' for everyone or 'private' for only the owner.

AUTO_STATUS_SEEN.description: Set to 'true' if you want the bot to automatically view statuses.

AUTO_READ.description: Set to 'true' if you want the bot to automatically read messages.

AUTO_TYPING.description: Set to 'true' if you want the bot to show 'typing...' before replying.

AUTO_RECORDING.description: Set to 'true' if you want the bot to show 'recording...' before replying.

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Set to 'true' to keep the bot's status always online.

REJECT_CALL.description: Set to 'true' to automatically reject incoming calls.
